positions.title: Multi-Media Journalist (Breaking News & Sports)
positions.description: The Mississippi News Group is expanding and looking for a motivated Multi-Media Journalist to join our growing digital newsroom. This position will focus heavily on breaking news coverage and sports reporting across North Mississippi.
positions.about:
We are a social-media-first digital media company reaching hundreds of thousands of readers and viewers each month. Our newsroom moves fast, and we are looking for someone who can gather information quickly, create compelling content, and connect with audiences across multiple platforms.

This is a remote position, but applicants must be based in or near DeSoto County, Mississippi to cover local events, breaking news, and sports in the area.
responsibilities: Cover breaking news stories across DeSoto County and surrounding areas
Report on local sports, including high school athletics and community events
Capture photos and video from events, games, and news scenes
Write clear, accurate, and engaging news and sports articles
Publish and promote content across social media platforms
Assist with live coverage, interviews, and event reporting
Work quickly and accurately in a fast-paced digital newsroom
qualifications: Covering live events and breaking news situations
Posting and promoting stories on social media
Following sports and understanding local athletics
requirements: Must live in or near DeSoto County, Mississippi
Strong interest in local news and sports coverage
Comfortable capturing photos, video, and written content
Reliable transportation for covering events and breaking news
Ability to work flexible hours when major news or sporting events occur
positions.applyNote: Send your resume and examples of your work (articles, photography, video, or social media content). Please include links or attachments that demonstrate your experience in news, sports coverage, photography, or video storytelling.

positions.title: Advertising & Marketing Sales Representative
positions.description: The Mississippi News Group is seeking an energetic and motivated Advertising & Marketing Sales Representative to join our growing media network.
positions.about:
This position will focus on helping businesses across North Mississippi grow through digital advertising, social media promotion, and marketing solutions across our network of local news and sports platforms.

Our media network reaches hundreds of thousands of readers and viewers each month, giving local businesses powerful tools to reach customers through digital ads, sponsored content, social media promotion, and broadcast exposure.

This position is based in or around DeSoto County, Mississippi, and will involve working with businesses throughout North Mississippi.
responsibilities: Build relationships with local businesses and organizations
Sell digital advertising and marketing packages across our news and sports platforms
Help clients develop effective advertising strategies
Prospect and identify new business opportunities
Manage existing advertiser accounts and ensure strong client satisfaction
Work with our editorial and production teams to coordinate advertising campaigns
Represent Mississippi News Group in the community and at local events
qualifications: Comfortable with sales and relationship building
Able to explain digital marketing and advertising solutions
Organized and capable of managing multiple client accounts
A strong communicator who can present ideas clearly
requirements: Must be based in or near DeSoto County, Mississippi
Reliable transportation for visiting clients across North Mississippi
Comfortable working independently and meeting sales goals
benefits: Access to a large and growing digital media audience
The opportunity to work with one of Mississippi's fastest growing digital media companies
positions.applyNote: Send your resume and any relevant sales or marketing experience.
